intro: Hands-on sessions every Thursday, and six years of past material that anyone can work through.

path.title: Come on a Thursday
path.text: Bring a laptop. Nothing is assumed, and you can start in any week.

path.title: Work through neural networks
path.text: Start with the neural networks material in the 2024 to 2025 library, in your own time.

path.title: Follow what interests you
path.text: Images, language or reinforcement learning: pick the next topic from the same series.

path.title: Join a project
path.text: When you want to build with other people, the projects team will find you a place.
